claimHolderRewards().notice: Claims accumulated holder-index rewards with no withdrawal fee.

creditRewardStake(address,uint256).notice: Protocol-controlled automatic staking of an already-earned RUSH reward.

distributeHolderRewards(uint256).notice: Accounts for holder-fee RUSH already received by this vault.

isSolvent().notice: True when actual ERC-20 custody covers all holder-vault liabilities.

recordRoundRush(uint256,uint256).notice: Manager-only: record a round-level RUSH deposit intended for winner staking.

stakingAssets().notice: RUSH principal explicitly backing outstanding staking shares.

totalRushLiabilities().notice: Total RUSH liabilities held by this vault: staking principal plus unclaimed holder rewards.

unallocatedRushBalance().notice: Custody that is neither staked principal nor allocated holder rewards.

withdraw(uint256).notice: Burns caller-owned staking shares and sends their net RUSH redemption.
